title: End-of-day balances drift when the file arrives out of order
prompt: Accounting flagged two days whose end-of-day balances don't match the sum of that day's transactions. data/transactions.jsonl arrived in a strange order, and src/ledger.mjs documents the rule that must hold regardless: transactions apply strictly in NUMERIC seq order — the running balances and the per-day snapshots in the result both depend on it. Reproduce by feeding applyTxns a shuffled array, find where the ordering rule is lost, fix it, and verify with your own script (applied order, final balances, end-of-day snapshots for every day, negative-balance and malformed-input guards).
